targetText: Alongside with the means of production and communication, land : the primary material of all human effort and the basis of all human existence : belongs to society.
summary: Bebel describes how socialist society will socialize land ownership, apply large-scale scientific agronomy, electric machinery, irrigation, and soil chemistry to agriculture, and abolish the historical antagonism between town and country through decentralized garden communities.
